run_create_cleaner_json: run the script to generate a cleaned object relations JSON from selected scene nodes
review_selected_nodes: review the hardcoded selected_nodes dictionary defining spatial relationships between scene objects
refactor_selected_nodes: refactor the selected_nodes dictionary to load object data from an external config file
summarize_object_relations: summarize the object relation pairs filtered by on_top_of relationships in the scene graph
build_object_relations_pipeline: build a python module to filter and assign IDs to scene graph nodes then output cleaned JSON
